method_note: The NSW Spatial Services public Lot layer (NSW_Land_Parcel_Property_Theme FeatureServer layer 8) was queried by lotidstring '1//DP857249' with outSR=4326 and returned exactly one polygon. Its planar centroid was computed with shapely 2.1.1 after projecting the polygon to EPSG:7856 (GDA2020 / MGA zone 56) with pyproj 3.7.1 (always_xy), then transformed back to EPSG:4326. No geocoder, web map, map link, embedded map widget or PeeringDB record was used. The NSW Planning Portal project page's own map point was read only as a cross-check, not as the locator.
